entry_digest.description: Digest of the submitted statement / envelope bytes or statement hash, per profile.

log_id.description: Identifier for the transparency service/log producing this receipt (e.g., key id or registry id).

mmd_seconds.description: Optional bounded-delay parameter for acknowledged receipts (MMD-style).

profile.description: Optional profile identifier (e.g., a SCITT receipt profile draft name).

receipt_type.description: Receipt family / profile identifier. SCITT receipts are commonly COSE-based.

root_hash.description: Tree root hash, if applicable (profile-defined encoding).
